Kiddopedia is a YouTube channel to find family-friendly educational videos. Our videos are intended for children as well as for adults to help them learn about different subjects such as animals, countries, flags, famous artworks, and English vocabulary. We are using lists of video clips and photographs and talk over them to bring the best educational value for our audience. In some of the videos, we add entertaining features as well as quizzes to make our videos more interactive and fun.

We have two small children at home. We show our videos that are targeted to children first to our own kids to get their reactions. We believe that the quality content is very important for the early development of their brain and association capabilities.
